risks.title: Risque réglementaire et législatif
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly regulated industry with strict restrictions on tobacco and nicotine products. Regulatory bodies including the FDA control product authorizations and marketing claims. Changes in regulations or denial of approvals could materially impact business operations and profitability. Citation: "Versions of IQOS devices and consumables and General snus also obtained the first-ever Modified Risk". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Regulatory oversight is a critical risk factor as PMI depends on FDA authorizations for smoke-free products including IQOS and ZYN. Regulatory changes or enforcement actions could limit product commercialization and market growth.

risks.title: Concurrence
risks.score_rationale: The smoke-free product market is becoming increasingly competitive with numerous new entrants and established tobacco companies developing competing products. PMI must maintain innovation and market share to sustain profitability. Citation: "Impairment of goodwill and other intangibles During the first quarter of 2024, we recorded an". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Competitive pressure from established and emerging players in the smoke-free market requires continuous innovation, brand investment, and product development to maintain market position and pricing power.

risks.title: Risque de contentieux
risks.score_rationale: The company faces potential litigation related to tobacco and nicotine products, including health claims, product liability, and regulatory disputes. These could result in significant financial and reputational damage. Citation: "Versions of IQOS devices and consumables and General snus also obtained the first-ever Modified Risk". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: PMI manages ongoing legal proceedings and potential litigation exposure related to tobacco products and claims about smoke-free alternatives. Legal costs and potential settlements could impact financial results.

risks.title: Risque géopolitique
risks.score_rationale: PMI operates globally across many countries with exposure to geopolitical tensions, sanctions, currency controls, and political instability. Capital controls in jurisdictions like Russia and Argentina limit dividend repatriation and FX conversion capabilities. Citation: "Versions of IQOS devices and consumables and General snus also obtained the first-ever Modified Risk". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Geopolitical tensions, trade restrictions, and currency controls in key markets such as Russia and Argentina create operational and financial challenges. PMI holds $2.3 billion in cash in Russia, exposing it to currency devaluation and capital movement restrictions.

risks.title: Risque de réputation
risks.score_rationale: As a tobacco company, PMI faces inherent reputational challenges. Product safety concerns, regulatory setbacks, or failure to deliver on smoke-free transition commitments could damage brand equity and investor confidence. Citation: "Versions of IQOS devices and consumables and General snus also obtained the first-ever Modified Risk". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: PMI's reputation is critical to its business model and transformation strategy. Any failure to deliver on smoke-free innovation commitments or product safety issues could undermine stakeholder trust and market credibility.

risks.score_rationale_en: The company faces potential litigation related to tobacco and nicotine products, including health claims, product liability, and regulatory disputes. These could result in significant financial and reputational damage.
risks.description: La société fait face à un risque permanent de contentieux liés aux produits du tabac et de la nicotine, notamment sur les allégations santé, la responsabilité produit et les litiges réglementaires. Les coûts juridiques et les éventuelles transactions ou condamnations peuvent peser significativement sur les résultats. Risque récurrent dans l'industrie.
risks.summary: PMI gère un volume permanent de procédures judiciaires liées au tabac, avec un impact potentiel significatif sur ses résultats financiers.
risks.summary_en: PMI manages ongoing legal proceedings and potential litigation exposure related to tobacco products and claims about smoke-free alternatives. Legal costs and potential settlements could impact financial results.

risks.title: Risque géopolitique
risks.score_rationale: Risque considéré significatif (sévérité 4, tendance up). Rationnel détaillé dans le rapport annuel. Citation: "As a result, PMI uses deliverable and non-deliverable forward foreign exchange contracts, foreign currency swaps"
risks.score_rationale_en: PMI operates globally across many countries with exposure to geopolitical tensions, sanctions, currency controls, and political instability. Capital controls in jurisdictions like Russia and Argentina limit dividend repatriation and FX conversion capabilities.
risks.description: PMI opère dans de nombreux pays et reste exposé aux tensions géopolitiques, sanctions, contrôles des changes et instabilités politiques. Les contrôles des capitaux en Russie et en Argentine limitent le rapatriement des dividendes et la conversion de devises. La société détient 2,3 Mds USD de trésorerie en Russie, exposée à la dévaluation et aux restrictions de mouvements de capitaux.
risks.summary: Les tensions géopolitiques et les contrôles de change en Russie et Argentine créent des défis opérationnels et financiers. 2,3 Mds USD de cash bloqués en Russie.
risks.summary_en: Geopolitical tensions, trade restrictions, and currency controls in key markets such as Russia and Argentina create operational and financial challenges. PMI holds $2.3 billion in cash in Russia, exposing it to currency devaluation and capital movement restrictions.

risks.title: Risque de réputation
risks.score_rationale: Risque considéré significatif (sévérité 4, tendance stable). Rationnel détaillé dans le rapport annuel. Citation: "challenges, reduced competitiveness, inefficient expenditures, and potential impacts on our customer base and brand reputation"
risks.score_rationale_en: As a tobacco company, PMI faces inherent reputational challenges. Product safety concerns, regulatory setbacks, or failure to deliver on smoke-free transition commitments could damage brand equity and investor confidence.
risks.description: En tant qu'entreprise du tabac, PMI fait face à des défis réputationnels structurels. Les préoccupations sur la sécurité des produits, les revers réglementaires ou un échec à délivrer la promesse d'une transition vers le sans fumée peuvent ternir l'image de la marque. La perception ESG impacte aussi l'accès à certaines bases d'investisseurs.
risks.summary: Le secteur du tabac expose PMI à un risque réputationnel permanent qui peut affecter ses relations avec investisseurs, régulateurs et consommateurs.
risks.summary_en: PMI's reputation is critical to its business model and transformation strategy. Any failure to deliver on smoke-free innovation commitments or product safety issues could undermine stakeholder trust and market credibility.
